Content settings control paragraph lines, list markers, emphasis, tables, and inline heading images

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"content\":{\"bullets\":\"*\",\"compact_tables\":true,\"extract_metadata\":false,\"keep_inline_images_in\":[\"h2\"],\"list_indent_width\":4,\"strip_newlines\":true,\"strong_em_symbol\":\"_\"}}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.Markdown!.Content);
```
